name: Elegant Post Manager – WordPress Posts Admin UI & Management Tool
author: amine48

sections.description:
Elegant Post Manager is a WordPress plugin that improves and modernizes the default WordPress posts admin interface.

It provides a cleaner and more powerful posts management dashboard inside the WordPress admin area.

With this plugin you can easily manage, filter, and organize your WordPress posts more efficiently.

It enhances the default WordPress posts screen with additional UI features while keeping core functionality intact.

Short Description

Modern WordPress posts management interface with advanced filtering and improved admin UI.

Features

  • Modern posts admin interface
  • Advanced search bar for posts
  • Filter posts by categories
  • Filter posts by post status (published, draft, etc.)
  • Filter posts by publication date
  • Display featured images (thumbnails)
  • Show number of comments per post
  • Show post status clearly
  • Elementor integration — quick edit with Elementor button on pages
  • Visit counter — track post views with search engine bot filtering
  • Plugin management — full plugin manager with bulk actions, upload & update
  • Update info modal — view changelog before updating plugins
  • Lightweight and fast performance
  • Better WordPress admin UX
sections.changelog:
1.1.5

  • New: Elementor quick edit button on Pages section
  • New: Delete Permanently option for trashed posts
  • New: Empty trash message with link back to all posts/pages
  • New: uninstall.php — clean post meta & transients on plugin deletion
  • New: Search engine bot filtering for visit counter
  • Security: Fixed ob_clean() with safe output buffering check
  • Performance: Replaced heavy WP_Query with direct $wpdb query for year filter
  • Performance: Refactored duplicate plugin update info fetching into shared function
  • Fix: Fixed 24 mistranslated text strings (textdomain → elegant-post-manager)
  • Fix: Removed unused inc/post_controll.php
  • Fix: Improved editor.js back-button selector for WordPress 6+ compatibility
  • Fix: Replaced hardcoded home_url() with admin_url() for new post link
  • UX: Loading spinner on update buttons in Plugin Manager
  • UX: Show update info modal for available plugin updates

1.1.4

  • Fix minor bugs
  • Restyling the Posts section
  • new Style For Pages Section In WordPress

1.1.2

  • Fix minor bugs
  • Improved Style in the plugins section
  • Fix the issue of plugins being disabled after update

1.0.2

  • Fix minor bugs
  • Improve plugin stability

1.0.1

  • UI improvements

1.0

  • Initial release
